title: Deep Object Filter
summary: Recursively filter a nested object or array with a predicate: keep the qualifying leaves, keep only the containers that still hold kept content, and return the filtered root (with a sentinel for an empty result whose exact form is not recorded).
inputFormat: A nested JSON-compatible value and a predicate function.
outputFormat: The filtered value, or the empty-root sentinel (form not recorded).
edgeRules: Whether the predicate applies to containers, whether arrays compact or keep holes, and the empty-root sentinel are not stated.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.note: Conditional: assumes containers are removed when empty and the predicate applies to leaves only.

factsMissing: Whether the predicate is applied to container values as well as leaves
What is returned when nothing survives (null, undefined, or an empty container)
Whether array elements are compacted or left as holes
questions: Is the predicate applied to container values as well as to leaf values?
What exact value is returned when nothing survives the filter?
Are removed array elements compacted or left as holes?
